entries.title: Dead Cells
entries.definitive_edition: Dead Cells: Medley of Pain Bundle on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 2D PC presentation with all DLC and final major update content.

primary.version: Medley of Pain Bundle / all DLC plus Update 35
primary.why: The Windows PC Medley of Pain Bundle is the best archival route because it bundles the base game with The Bad Seed, Fatal Falls, The Queen and the Sea, Return to Castlevania, and the free Rise of the Giant DLC while preserving PC capture/settings flexibility. Update 35, The End is Near, is the final major content update, so the current PC build is the clean complete-content target.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Dead Cells: Medley of Pain Bundle on Steam for Windows PC and update the game to the current build. Confirm the paid DLC packs and free updates through Update 35 are installed before a complete run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with Medley of Pain bundle and Update 35 support.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete DLC route with PC capture/settings flexibility.
skip: useful native routes, but Windows PC remains the main capture/settings target.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable console release with DLC access.
all_releases.reason: skip: portable route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: complete console route exists, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: complete console route exists, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile ports, including a Netflix mobile edition with the previously released DLCs.
all_releases.reason: skip: convenient mobile route, but native PC is preferred for archival capture, controls, and display.
skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows PC bundle route includes the paid expansions and current free-update content, so the fidelity-first and complete-content recommendations align.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is required for the PC route. The key completeness caveat is to use the current build after Update 35, The End is Near, and install all paid gameplay DLC.
